name: Titania

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Debilitate: Debilitate dışında yeni uygulanan debuff'ların süresini uzatır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Decelerate: Unstoppable ve Kaçış (Evade) yetenek doğruluğunu sabit bir miktarda azaltır.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Falter: Rakibin bir sonraki saldırısının ıskalamasına sebep olur.
abilityDetails.Stifle: Saldırı Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Cowardice: Özel saldırı hasarını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Intimidate: Blok şansını artırır, blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Grudge Match
Whenever Titania inflicts a stackable personal Debuff, she has a [10 - 30]% chance to inflict it twice.
When fighting #L and #XL Opponents, Titania's Fury potency is increased by [10 - 30]%.
immunityDetails:
• Buff Bağışıklığı 🗡️🚫
• Kanama Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Absorbing Man) 🩸

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Titania is immune to Buffs. She doesn't need your help.

abilitySections.title: Haymakers
content: Performing a Dash, a second Medium Attack, or charging a Heavy Attack grants Titania Unblockable, Unstoppable, and Indestructible Passives for 4 seconds. 30 second cooldown.
While these effects are active, each hit deals a burst of [479.1] Physical Damage for each Debuff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Adding Injury to Insult
content: Whenever the Opponent is inflicted with a Debuff, Titania gains a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by +[958.2] for 15 seconds, and Haymakers' cooldown is reduced by 1 second.
All of Titania's Debuffs can be inflicted through Block.

abilitySections.title: Light Attacks
content: Inflict a 5% Suppression Debuff for 2 seconds, paused during Titania's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit inflicts a Stagger Debuff for 8 seconds.

If the first hit lands while Haymakers' effects are active, the final hit inflicts an extra stack of Titania's active personal Debuffs. If this attack is canceled into a Special Attack, the extra Debuffs are inflicted on the final hit of the Special instead.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The first hit inflicts a non-stacking Debilitate Debuff, extending the duration of any new Debuffs by 50% for 30 seconds.
Each hit inflicts a Weakness Debuff, reducing Attack Rating by 5% for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a non-stacking [687.5] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 20 seconds. This Debuff is refreshed whenever the Opponent suffers 4 or more Suppression Debuffs.
Each hit inflicts a Weakness Debuff, reducing Attack Rating by 5% for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Immediately activate Haymakers with +50% duration, ignoring their cooldown.
Inflict 30% potency Fatigue, Exhaustion, Decelerate, Disorient, Falter, Stifle, Wither, Petrify, Cowardice, and Intimidate Debuffs on the Opponent for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Grudge Match
content: Whenever Titania inflicts a stackable personal Debuff, she has a [10 - 30]% chance to inflict it twice.
When fighting #L and #XL Opponents, Titania's Fury potency is increased by [10 - 30]%.
